request.style: English, male soulful blues voice, solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, organ, brushed drums, melancholic and hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Blessed are the meek, they inherit the earth
Hunger for righteousness, their hearts are worth
Mercy flows to those who show it first
Pure in heart, seeing the divine burst

[Chorus]
Blessed are the pure in heart
For they will see God apart
Blessed are the pure in heart
For they will see God apart

[Verse]
Peacemakers called sons of the divine
Persecuted for right, the kingdom is thine
Insults and lies, spoken against your name
Rejoice in this truth, free from shame

[Chorus]
Blessed are the pure in heart
For they will see God apart
Blessed are the pure in heart
For they will see God apart

[Bridge]
The earth is theirs, the fill is given
Mercy received, the merciful are living
Pure in heart, the vision is clear
God is seen, drawing near

[Outro]
Blessed are the pure in heart
For they will see God apart
